title: Segmented, with the head snippet
description: The default: every choice on the segmented track, System checked until someone picks. The head snippet applies the stored choice before first paint, so the page never flashes the wrong theme.

title: Icon button
description: One button that switches between light and dark, for a top bar. Its name says what it does next.

title: Menu, bound to a setting
description: A Theme button that opens the choices as radio items, with System last. Bind the choice to save it with the account; value-change fires only when the person picks.
